text.arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: the divine proper name as the subject of a sustained identity-predicate, opening public divine scope before the closing relational Lord title
words.root_gloss_range: worship/refuge and divine-name range, with contested bewildered-turning pressure kept only as background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens the ayah as the subject of one sustained identity claim: the raised heavens, throne establishment, harnessed luminaries, managed affair, detailed signs, and final purpose all predicate who God is. The word also frames the ayah with the later relational Lord title, so public divine identity becomes personally addressed evidence. Worship/refuge and bewildered-turning pressure remain lexical background for a cosmic proof meant to move the audience toward certainty; the same order becomes worship-site contrast later in the surah (13:15) and rhetorical interrogation about lordship over the heavens (13:16).

topics.headline: divine name governs the whole predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every later action is predicated of the opening divine name as one sustained identity claim.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies the word as the nominative subject of a nominal sentence whose predicate is the long relative clause.

topics.headline: opening name closes into your Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from universal divine identity to personally addressed lordship.
topics.reason: The opening proper name and the later relational title create a clear ayah-level frame.

topics.headline: worship pressure and local echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear worship and bewildered-turning pressure around the name, while the local grammar still keeps it as the divine proper name.
topics.reason: The etymological dispute and co-occurrence rows are useful as pressure, but they do not replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: description becomes question elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same cosmic-order material can later be turned into a rhetorical question (13:16).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah comparison supports a local contrast between declarative proof and later interrogation.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun linking the opening divine name to the whole action-chain as its defining predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) is the grammatical hinge that makes the following cosmic catalogue a defining clause for the opening name. The reader is not given separate events loosely attached to God, but a single identity-predicate running through the ayah.

topics.headline: relative clause makes action identity-defining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic actions define who the opening subject is, rather than floating as separate events.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the long qualifying clause attached to the divine name.

words.gloss_range: completed direct raising of the heavens, with physical elevation selected and rank-exaltation pressure retained
words.root_gloss_range: raising, elevation, exaltation, and transmission range; local celestial object selects physical raising
words.prose: {{ar:رَفَعَ}} ({{tr:rafaʿa}}) begins the action-chain with an accomplished act of elevation. Physical raising is selected by the heavenly object, while the root's wider exaltation pressure makes the lifted heavens part of the ayah's proof-architecture. Its Form I perfect assigns direct divine agency, not self-rising or iterative lifting, and the raised-heaven formula recalls the balance-linked raising scene (55:7); the central guttural gives the first cosmic act audible weight before the verse opens upward.

topics.headline: completed raising begins the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the raising as an accomplished first act that grounds later ongoing motion and governance.
topics.reason: The perfect verb begins the relative action-chain and contrasts with later imperfects.

topics.headline: physical lifting with exaltation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens are physically raised, while the root still gives that elevation dignity and proof-status.
topics.reason: The celestial object selects physical raising; broader rank and report branches remain only lexical pressure.

topics.headline: direct Form I agency in a celestial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees direct divine agency in a familiar raised-heaven formula (55:7), not self-rising or iterative lifting.
topics.reason: The surface is Form I perfect with a celestial object, and the row gives a concrete formula parallel.

topics.headline: heavy articulation of the lifting verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice the first cosmic action carrying audible weight before the phrase opens upward.
topics.reason: The phonetic row coheres with the central guttural in the verb and does not alter the lexical parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite plural upper realms as the object raised, carrying concrete overhead and total-scope force
words.root_gloss_range: elevation, above-ness, sky/heaven, and naming/designation family; local noun selects elevated heavens
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) is the definite plural object raised, so the proof begins with all the known upper realms acted upon directly. The word keeps the heavens concrete as sky, canopy, ceiling, and rain-bearing above, not just an abstract upper-realm label. Its root-family echo with the later named term lets the ayah bind elevated space to specified time without confusing the two forms, and the same noun is later shifted into a lordship question (13:16).

topics.headline: definite plural heavens are the raised object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all the known upper realms are acted upon directly, not used merely as scenery.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the object of the raising verb, and the definite plural gives total upper-realm scope.

topics.headline: concrete above-architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the heavens as overhead architecture: sky, canopy, ceiling, and rain-bearing above, not an abstract label.
topics.reason: The local noun licenses the sky/heaven branch and the supportless-raising frame makes the concrete architecture relevant.

topics.headline: elevation echoes later named term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root-family linking raised space with named time inside the ayah.
topics.reason: The local recurrence between the heavens and the later named term supports a controlled root-family echo.

topics.headline: same root takes distinct local forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root functioning across cosmic scope, timing, and governance without collapsing the distinct local forms.
topics.reason: The rows supply co-occurrence and same-surah contrasts while local morphology keeps the noun distinct from the passive participle.

words.gloss_range: prepositional connection turned privative by the following other-than phrase, specifying the manner of raising
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the support phrase to the raising and turns connection into privation through the following other-than word. The result is not just that the heavens are raised, but that their manner of being raised is marked by absent supports.

topics.headline: connection becomes withoutness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the supportless condition is grammatically inserted as the manner of raising.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the raising clause and, with the following other-than word, creates a privative phrase.

words.gloss_range: construct head of privation: other-than pillars, not vague unsupportedness
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, difference, absence, and change; local construct selects privative contrast
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) makes absence precise by governing the support noun in construct. The word selects privation here, while its otherness field makes the phrase a contrast against ordinary load-bearing architecture. The same root later becomes change-language in the surah (13:11), so cosmic other-than support here and human alteration there remain linked without merging their local senses.

topics.headline: absence made syntactically concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording denies a specific support category, not support in a vague way.
topics.reason: The construct relation governs the pillar noun and defines the privation precisely.

topics.headline: otherness pressure in the privative phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the phrase as a contrast against ordinary architecture while still reading it locally as without pillars.
topics.reason: The root's difference and change fields color the privation, but the local phrase selects absence rather than an alternative hidden instrument.

topics.headline: absence root later becomes change language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the same root from cosmic other-than support here to human change conditions later in the surah (13:11).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah recurrence is useful as a controlled thread, not as a replacement for the local privative sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite supports or pillars whose absence is made visible and interpretively open
words.root_gloss_range: pillars, props, upright supports, and deliberate aiming/intention; local phrase selects denied structural support
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَدٍ}} ({{tr:ʿamadin}}) names the denied supports as an open, indefinite category. The following seeing verb leaves a productive fork: either pillars that would be visible are denied, or the visible heavens themselves are seen without such supports. The denied image is not generic support but poles, columns, and vertical load-bearing members, with accepted variant pressure making the pillars feel more massed; the root's deliberate-aiming field adds no-need-for-propping pressure, and the rare support word contrasts divine pillarless construction with earthly pillar architecture (89:7).

topics.headline: indefinite pillars and sight-clause fork
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the interpretive fork: visible heavens without supports or supports that would be seen.
topics.reason: The indefinite support noun followed by the seeing verb permits both attachment routes.

topics.headline: vivid denied load-bearing architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denied supports as concrete poles or columns, with the variant making that image heavier.
topics.reason: The noun and accepted variant both remain within the support branch and sharpen the denied architecture.

topics.headline: support and deliberate propping pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses not only missing physical supports but also no need for deliberate propping; local sense remains pillars.
topics.reason: The broader root field adds deliberate-action pressure, but the phrase itself selects the physical support noun.

topics.headline: rare support word intensifies the absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare support root makes the absence marked, especially against earthly pillar architecture (89:7).
topics.reason: The distribution and concrete comparison support interpretive weight without changing the local noun.

words.gloss_range: second-person seeing with a feminine suffix that can route perception toward heavens or supports
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, judging, and vision; local form makes audience perception evidential
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَوْنَهَا}} ({{tr:tarawnahā}}) makes the audience's perception part of the proof. The suffix is the pivot: it can route sight toward the heavens or toward the denied supports, while the verb's seeing/judging range turns eyesight into evidential recognition. Variant pressure confirms the suffix as the pressure point, so both attachment routes still serve the ayah's visible-evidence logic rather than becoming a purely grammatical curiosity.

topics.headline: second-person seeing makes evidence current
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is made to see and judge the evidence directly, not merely hear a report.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person imperfect, and the root range supports physical perception with evaluative recognition.

topics.headline: suffix ambiguity controls what is seen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the feminine suffix can point the observation toward the heavens or toward the denied supports.
topics.reason: The local attachment evidence allows the seeing clause to work as the structural pivot of the supportless-heavens phrase.

topics.headline: visible evidence becomes a productive fork
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both readings still serve the ayah's visible-evidence logic, with variant pressure highlighting the suffix as decisive.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and qiraat rows confirm perception as the bridge from cosmic surface to evidential certainty.

words.gloss_range: delayed sequence marker moving from completed raising to sovereign establishment
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) prevents the raising and throne-establishment from collapsing into one simultaneous image. It moves the ayah from pillarless construction into sovereign establishment as a second ordered beat.

topics.headline: then moves construction into sovereignty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that raising and establishment are ordered beats, with the second turning construction imagery into governance imagery.
topics.reason: The particle marks sequence with delay or rank and links the first cosmic act to the throne clause.

words.gloss_range: settled establishment over the throne, selected by the following over-preposition while retaining equilibrium pressure
words.root_gloss_range: evenness, leveling, settling, maturity, and establishment; local construction selects sovereign establishment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:istawā}}) is selected by the over-throne construction as sovereign establishment, not a mere turning toward something. The root's equilibrium field still matters: the authority is presented as settled order, then specialized locally into cosmic administration. The sevenfold throne formula (7:54; 10:3; 13:2; 20:5; 25:59; 32:4; 57:4) is therefore not left abstract here; it feeds directly into ordering sun, moon, affair, and signs.

topics.headline: over-preposition selects establishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construction selects sovereign establishment over the throne, not a mere turning toward it.
topics.reason: The following over-preposition selects the establishment-upon reading rather than the toward construction.

topics.headline: authority colored by equilibrium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels sovereignty as settled and ordered equilibrium, while local grammar keeps authority as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root and form support evenness and settling pressure, but the throne construction selects authority.

topics.headline: formulaic throne establishment specializes locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the sevenfold throne formula (7:54; 10:3; 13:2; 20:5; 25:59; 32:4; 57:4) as locally aimed toward cosmic administration.
topics.reason: The recurring formula survives as inter-ayah evidence, while the local continuation specializes it through luminary harnessing and administration.

topics.headline: sovereignty becomes cosmic management
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formula does not remain abstract; here it feeds directly into ordering sun, moon, affair, and signs.
topics.reason: The local continuation after the formula supports this specialization.

words.gloss_range: upon/over preposition completing the establishment phrase and activating authority-over force
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) supplies the constructional force that completes the establishment phrase. Spatial upon and authority over work together, making the throne relation both image and governance.

topics.headline: upon turns settling into rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spatial upon and authority over work together to complete the throne-establishment phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the throne and supplies the constructional force needed for authority-over reading.

words.gloss_range: the definite throne as a known sovereign framework and hinge toward administration
words.root_gloss_range: throne, roof, canopy, and trellis framework; local formula selects cosmic throne with structural imagery
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿarshi}}) is the definite cosmic throne, a known sovereign framework rather than an indefinite seat. Its canopy/trellis root pressure keeps the image structurally concrete, and its position hinges completed creation toward ongoing administration. The establishment-throne formula recurs across other scenes (7:54; 10:3; 20:5; 25:59; 32:4; 57:4), while the repeated guttural texture in the authority phrase audibly binds the preposition and throne.

topics.headline: known throne framework
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the throne as a recognized cosmic frame tied to establishment, command, and lordship.
topics.reason: The definite noun belongs to the recurring establishment-over-throne formula and its governance network.

topics.headline: throne with canopy and trellis imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels authority through elevated framework imagery, while the local formula keeps throne as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root-family range adds structural imagery without replacing the throne reading.

topics.headline: pivot from making to managing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the throne phrase as the hinge between completed creation acts and ongoing governance verbs.
topics.reason: The word's position sits between perfect creation/subjugation clauses and later imperfect administration/detailing.

topics.headline: guttural phrase binds preposition and throne
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the authority phrase as a bound unit through repeated guttural articulation.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation reinforces the local preposition-governed phrase without changing its grammar.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding luminary subjugation to the establishment sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the harnessing of the luminaries as a new act while keeping it inside the same divine action-chain. The sequence continues rather than restarting as an unrelated sentence.

topics.headline: coordination keeps subjugation in the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices luminary harnessing as a new beat inside the same divine action-chain.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next perfect verb with the prior establishment sequence.

words.gloss_range: completed causative harnessing of the sun and moon into ordered service
words.root_gloss_range: mockery/subordination and causative subjugation; local Form II selects harnessing into service
words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) marks completed causative harnessing: the sun and moon are made serviceable before each continues running. The root's hierarchy pressure survives as ordered service, while the local Form II selects cosmic subjugation rather than mockery. The sun-moon harnessing formula recurs in cosmic governance passages (31:29; 35:13; 39:5) and belongs to a wider creation-governance sequence (7:54; 16:12; 31:29; 35:13).

topics.headline: completed divine subjugation enables motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sun and moon run because they have already been harnessed under divine ordering.
topics.reason: The perfect active verb governs both luminaries and precedes the ongoing running clause.

topics.headline: mockery-root hierarchy becomes service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels subjugation as placing powerful bodies beneath command for service, while mockery itself is not the local sense.
topics.reason: The broader root tension explains hierarchy, but Form II and objects select harnessing.

topics.headline: Form II cosmic-harnessing formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurrent cosmic-harnessing formula (31:29; 35:13; 39:5) with causative force.
topics.reason: The Form II morphology and recurrence with sun and moon license the formulaic reading.

topics.headline: creation-governance sequence repeats elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sun-moon subjugation as part of a wider creation-governance sequence (7:54; 16:12; 31:29; 35:13).
topics.reason: The row gives concrete parallels and the local order fits the pattern.

words.gloss_range: the definite sun as first harnessed luminary, with intense/restive energy made tractable
words.root_gloss_range: sunlight and restive intensity; local object role selects the sun under harnessing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) is the first harnessed luminary object. The sun's intensity and restive root pressure sharpen the payoff: the dominant luminous force is made tractable within a recurrent sun-moon service formula, then included in the term-bound running that follows.

topics.headline: sun as first harnessed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sun as an acted-upon body under harnessing and term-bound motion.
topics.reason: The accusative case marks the sun as the first object of the harnessing verb.

topics.headline: solar intensity made tractable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the dominant luminous force as something made tractable, while the local sense remains the sun.
topics.reason: The root's restive pressure sharpens the harnessing image but does not add a separate lexical sense here.

topics.headline: sun-moon pair under divine service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sun as half of a recurrent visible-luminary pair under ordered service.
topics.reason: The pair recurs in cosmic formulae and is locally governed by one verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the moon to the sun under one harnessing verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the moon to the sun under the same harnessing verb. The pair is gathered first, then distributed by the later each-one clause.

topics.headline: moon bound to sun under one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sun and moon form one coordinated object pair before each is distributed into motion.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the moon with the sun under the same harnessing verb.

words.gloss_range: the definite moon as coordinated harnessed luminary, adding reflected and cyclical light to the pair
words.root_gloss_range: moonlight, brightness, and night-risk associations; local object role selects the moon under harnessing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) shares the sun's object role under harnessing. Its reflected, cyclical light and risk-tinged night pressure are brought into the same ordered service as the sun's dominant radiance, completing the familiar sun-moon formula.

topics.headline: moon shares the harnessed object role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon is equally under the same harnessing and term-bound running network.
topics.reason: The accusative coordinated noun shares the object relation with the sun.

topics.headline: moonlight and night pressure harnessed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels reflected and destabilizing night light brought under order, while the local sense remains the moon.
topics.reason: The root range adds light and night-risk pressure without replacing the local lunar object.

topics.headline: moon completes the luminary formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees dominant and reflected light absorbed together into one ordered cosmic service.
topics.reason: The local coordination and recurrence rows support the formulaic pair.

words.gloss_range: indefinite eachness distributing the paired luminaries into individually running units
words.root_gloss_range: allness, every-one, and totality; local tanwīn form selects each one of the prior set
words.prose: {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) resets the syntax into a generalizing nominal sentence. The paired luminaries become each one individually accountable: not merely harnessed together, but distributed into separate courses toward a term. The same each/all thread later crosses from cosmic courses into social guidance and appointed terms (13:7; 13:38).

topics.headline: each one supplied from prior set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the paired luminaries are now distributed one by one.
topics.reason: The indefinite nominative starts a new nominal sentence and leaves the prior set implicit.

topics.headline: totality distributed into individual courses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cosmic totality not as a blur but as each member running to its term.
topics.reason: The tanwīn form yields each-one distribution and pairs with the running and term fields.

topics.headline: new sentence generalizes the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the syntax shift from divine acts to continuing celestial behavior.
topics.reason: The nominal sentence interrupts the perfect-verb chain and states ongoing behavior.

topics.headline: totality crosses cosmic and social frames
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track each/all language from cosmic courses here into guidance and appointed terms later in the surah (13:7; 13:38).
topics.reason: The same-surah rows give concrete recurrences and do not overrule the local sun-moon set.

words.gloss_range: ongoing coursing or running of each luminary toward a bounded term
words.root_gloss_range: flowing, running, proceeding, orbiting, and course-following; local subjects select celestial coursing
words.prose: {{ar:يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:yajrī}}) changes the view from completed harnessing to ongoing coursing. Its flow/run root image makes celestial motion feel continuous, and the verb's glide-like sound supports that course before the deadline phrase closes it. The formula of bodies running toward a named term recurs elsewhere (31:29; 35:13; 39:5), so the motion is continuous but not indefinite.

topics.headline: imperfect running continues after harnessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices completed subjugation producing continuing motion, not a completed run.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb follows the perfect harnessing verb and is bounded by the term phrase.

topics.headline: coursing retains flow imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels celestial motion as a continuous course or flow along an appointed channel.
topics.reason: The subjects select celestial coursing while the root range preserves flow and proceeding imagery.

topics.headline: continuous but not indefinite motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the formula of bodies running toward a named term (31:29; 35:13; 39:5).
topics.reason: The local phrase matches the recurring term-bound motion formula and integrates harnessing, eachness, running, term, and naming.

topics.headline: glide supports continuous motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the running verb's sound carrying the sense of continuous course before the deadline closes it.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports but does not control the semantic parse.

words.gloss_range: preposition making the running purposive and endpoint-directed
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) attaches the term phrase to the running verb. The motion is for a term and toward a term, so the course is both purposeful and finite.

topics.headline: for and toward a term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motion is both purposive and finite, directed to a bounded term.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the running verb and governs the term noun.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite term or deadline that is unknown to the audience yet immediately qualified as specified
words.root_gloss_range: fixed term, lifespan, deferred period, and due date; local phrase selects bounded cosmic terminus
words.prose: {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}) names the endpoint as a term that remains indefinite to the audience but is immediately qualified as specified. Lifespan and due-date pressure make cosmic motion feel finite and obligated to an appointed end, while the running-plus-named-term formula gives that course a built-in terminus.

topics.headline: indefinite term specified by adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deadline is hidden from the audience but already specified within the divine order.
topics.reason: The term is indefinite and immediately qualified by the named/specified participle.

topics.headline: cosmic motion has a due endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels cosmic running as finite like a lifespan or debt due date, while local sense remains appointed term.
topics.reason: The root's lifespan and due-date range colors the term without making the luminaries debtors literally.

topics.headline: running with named term formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the term as part of a fixed formula of motion with a built-in endpoint.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence joins the running verb, term noun, and named participle in the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: passive participial designation of the term as already named or specified
words.root_gloss_range: elevation and naming/designation, with possible marking pressure; local passive participle selects named specification
words.prose: {{ar:مُّسَمًّى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) qualifies the term as already named or specified. As a passive participle it implies a prior designation, and its root-family echo with the raised heavens binds spatial elevation to temporal naming. The designation feels like elevation into specificity, with possible marking pressure, while the local grammar keeps the selected sense as named or specified.

topics.headline: term already named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint has already been designated by an unstated divine agent.
topics.reason: The passive participle agrees with the term noun and implies prior designation.

topics.headline: designation echoes elevation and marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels naming as elevation into specificity and possibly marking, while local grammar selects specified/named.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute and root family add pressure but do not replace the passive participle's local designation sense.

topics.headline: raised space closes as named time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ordering both space and time through the same root-family echo.
topics.reason: The local root reprise from heavens to named term is form-distinct but semantically productive.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form II administration of the definite affair by outcome-aware ordering
words.root_gloss_range: back/rear, consequence, reflection, and active administration; local Form II selects managed ordering
words.prose: {{ar:يُدَبِّرُ}} ({{tr:yudabbiru}}) presents divine administration as ongoing and object-focused. The root's rear/consequence image makes management feel outcome-aware, and the adjacent detailing verb turns governance and communication into paired functions. The accepted first-person variant exposes a report-versus-self-declaration pressure point, and the doubled consonant gives the management verb a compressed, deliberate sound.

topics.headline: ongoing management of the definite affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices administration as continuous and aimed at a definite object, not a detached divine attribute.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form II verb governs the explicit definite object.

topics.headline: behindness becomes outcome-aware order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine management as ordering from consequences and ends, while local sense remains administration.
topics.reason: The root image of back/rear survives as planning pressure through the Form II management verb.

topics.headline: variant exposes report versus self-declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same governance can be reported in third person or voiced as divine self-reference in the variant.
topics.reason: The accepted variant is useful as apparatus but does not replace the canonical local third-person surface.

topics.headline: administration pairs with sign-detailing

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رفع السماوات؛ سخر الشمس والقمر؛ كل يجري لأجل مسمى؛ يدبر الأمر ويفصل الآيات
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation, purposive subjection, regular motion to a bounded time, outcome-aware management, and articulated signs form one timed administration rather than a list of unrelated wonders.

activation_trace.role: Physical elevation supplies the raised spatial field on which the mechanism operates.
Subjection that drives something toward a purpose makes the luminaries functional components.
Flowing motion supplies the ongoing execution of the order.
A bounded duration gives every course a temporal limit.
Considering an affair's outcome makes governance prospective rather than merely initiatory.
Detailing parts and meanings makes the administered order cognitively legible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists feats of divine power in the sky.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents the cosmos as a timed administration whose motions, limits, and explanations are coordinated toward encounter.

baseline_models.mechanism: Negation, architectural support, and sight leave two live attachments: the heavens are seen raised with no pillars, or the negated pillars are specifically pillars one can see, leaving support outside perception.

activation_trace.role: Negation and exclusion open the support phrase's two attachment possibilities.
Propping a thing with a support supplies the literal architectural expectation being denied or hidden.
Vision can qualify either the raised heavens or the availability of their supports to observers.

changed_reading.before: The heavens simply have no pillars.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies terrestrial extension, fixity, channels, common roots, and one-water differentiation; I infer these effects as an analogy for non-columnar support; alternatively they are only a heaven-earth contrast.

changed_reading.after: The term can govern the whole measured development of a course, including concealed decrease and increase before its completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: What sight catches as lightning develops through generated heavy cloud, descent, measured valleys, and flood flow; the raised heaven is therefore an active transfer infrastructure whose hidden governance becomes visible downstream.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies the ordered weather-to-valley sequence; I infer a continuous infrastructure as an instance of unseen management; alternatively the units are separate signs with no asserted causal chain beyond rainfall.

changed_reading.after: The heavens operate as a dynamic transfer field: governance unseen at one stage becomes legible as measured flow and differentiated effects at another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun's governed course writes moving shadows at morning and evening; those shadows enact prostration across willing and unwilling subjects, converting celestial subjection into a visible temporal practice on earth.

changed_reading.after: Their governed motion also produces an involuntary daily liturgy in bodies and shadows, making cosmic obedience socially and visually present.

changed_reading.after: Detailing can be an experiential separation process in which flow, time, and consequence distinguish flashy surface from enduring benefit.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies repeated running plus bounded time in the focus and enduring provision in the garden; I infer a temporal contrast and transition; alternatively permanence modifies only yield and shade, not the rivers or the focus's scope.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every term is paired with an inscription, then erasure and establishment occur before a source-book; the named term becomes a registered allocation nested within active administration rather than an inert, self-executing fate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses royal and horticultural domains; it remains anchored in the focus's explicit trellis branch for عرش and is activated by nearby grapes and fruit; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not replace the throne's royal sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: العرش, read through its trellis branch within the raised and governed creation

activation_trace.role: A raised trellis for vines supplies an alternate material image of an ordering frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because جري normally contributes motion here; it remains anchored in 'each runs,' purposive subjection, and the packet's agent branch, with contextual sending as activation; downstream prose should qualify it as an administrative metaphor, not claim that the luminaries are literally messengers.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-directed subjection gives the running entities an assigned function.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are inert bodies moving on controlled paths.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are commissioned runners executing bounded assignments within the management of the affair.

strongest_changes: The pillar phrase preserves absent-support and unseen-support readings, then terrestrial networks add a third model of distributed support visible through effects.
The named term expands from an endpoint into measured development, reality-accountable designation, and an inscribed allocation under active administration.
Weather, valleys, shadows, and foam turn cosmic governance from a static tableau into flows that reveal ordering, obedience, and discernment over time.
Repeated running alongside enduring garden provision keeps a live contrast between finite cosmic courses and a later regime of persistent benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mapped roots made naming also activate marking, while repeated focus roots in later ayat connected sight, running, term, and throne to material sequences without collapsing their competing readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The attachment of ترونها does not settle whether supports are absent or merely unseen.
It remains uncertain whether 13:39's erasure and establishment directly govern the terms of 13:38 or another class of written contents.
The permanence in 13:35 explicitly qualifies yield and shade, so its contrast with bounded running should not be extended to every garden feature without caution.
The trellis and commissioned-runner outliers are productive analogies, not lexical replacements for throne and ordinary celestial motion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `د ب ر/B006` is management by considering outcomes; `د ب ر/B001–B002` adds rear and trailing end. Cosmic raising, settling, subjection, and timed running precede management, while `ع ق ب` later marks consequence (13:22–25, 35, 42). I infer ordering backward from appointed ends; `يُدَبِّرُ` reads as outcome-oriented governance.
2. `س و ي/B003` is rising and settling, and `ع ر ش/B003` supplies a vine trellis alongside the throne. Gardens recur in 13:3–4 and 35. By material analogy, I infer that elevated governance supports differentiated growth as a trellis does; this secondary reading coexists with the royal-throne image.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repeated `عُقْبَى` clauses made final consequence the clearest explanation of `د ب ر`, while 13:35 revived the trellis image.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Outcome-aware administration made legible in parts.** `د ب ر / B006` is managing by considering outcomes; `ف ص ل / B013` is detailing that clarifies parts and meanings; `ج ر ي / B002` is a habitual course. The fixed sequence moves from running celestial bodies toward a named term, then from administration toward differentiated signs. Nearby 13:3-4 show repeatable terrestrial courses, while 13:5-7 turn to denied outcome, punishment, warning, and guidance. I assign `د ب ر` the role of backward-looking design from an end, and `ف ص ل` the role of exposing that design in inspectable units. The packet supplies courses, term, details, and consequences; I infer anticipated end -> ordered present course. The ayah thus reads as governance calibrated from outcomes and disclosed through separable signs, not simply as a list of powers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:6's ordered pairing of forgiveness and punitive consequence made `د ب ر / B006` newly temporal: administration considers a delayed outcome while preserving an interval before it. 13:7 then made detailed signs serve guidance rather than display alone.

baseline.text: Allah, gökleri gördüğünüz direkler olmadan yükseltendir. Sonra Arş'a kurulmuş, güneşi ve ayı buyruğu altına almıştır. Her biri belirlenmiş bir süreye kadar akıp gider. O, işi düzenler ve ayetleri ayrıntılı açıklar ki Rabbinizle karşılaşmaya kesin olarak inanasınız.

findings.text: İşin düzenlenmesi, belirlenmiş sonları hesaba katarak bugünkü akışları geriye doğru biçimlendiren sonuç odaklı bir yönetimdir.
Ayetlerin ayrıntılı açıklanması, bu sonuç odaklı düzeni parçaları incelenebilir bir yapı halinde görünür kılar.
Arş'a kurulma, bahçe görüntüleriyle birlikte, yönetimin farklı gelişmeleri taşıyan bir asma iskelesi gibi okunmasını da mümkün kılar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Raised Frame and Scheduled Motion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A stable elevated frame orders movement beneath and within it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cosmic order materializes as both load-bearing architecture and a timed itinerary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Elevated Canopy and Supports
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A roof-like upper structure is raised, propped, and made the frame of rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: raised body or building (`quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`); support placed beneath a structure (`quranic:root_001043:B002/m01`); column or mainstay (`quranic:root_001043:B003/m01`); raised roof or canopy (`quranic:root_001000:B002/m01`); sky as what rises and overshadows (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `رَفَعَ` (ر ف ع), `عَمَد` (ع م د), `العَرْش` (ع ر ش), and `السَّمَاوَات` (س م و).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Raising, supporting, roofing, and overshadowing form one construction scene. The unseen columns do not empty the image of material force; they make support itself the latent invariant beneath the visible heaven.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Raised Frame and Scheduled Motion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A stable elevated frame orders movement beneath and within it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cosmic order materializes as both load-bearing architecture and a timed itinerary.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Celestial Course and Appointment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Luminous bodies travel along a continuing course until a fixed endpoint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: flowing motion of sun and other bodies (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); sun and its light (`quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`); moon and its light (`quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`); appointed temporal limit (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); reflective ordering by the outcome of an affair (`quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:2 `يَجْرِي` (ج ر ي), `الشَّمْس` (ش م س), `القَمَر` (ق م ر), `أَجَل` (ء ج ل), and `يُدَبِّرُ` (د ب ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The course is not motion alone: sun and moon move toward an appointment under administration that already regards the end. Time is pictured as a traversable, governed route.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Water Gathered, Routed, and Made Fruitful
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water becomes life-bearing when it is caught, directed, apportioned, and delivered to growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same hydrology extends backward into rock basins and hidden sinks and forward into managed irrigation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Catchments, Wells, and Hidden Sinks
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Depressions and built holding places catch water before release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reservoir collecting well, channel, or rain water (`quranic:root_000016:B007/m01`); hollow retaining water for days (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); rock hollow or newly cut well (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); hidden low sink where water gathers (`quranic:root_001120:B002/m01`); timbered wellhead and station of the water drawer (`quranic:root_001000:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Basin, hollow, sink, and wellhead form a complete capture scene. These latent containers give material depth to the measured waters later released across the land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Information Made Manifest and Answerable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is hidden becomes perceptible, articulate, transmitted, and open to response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visibility, articulate differentiation, warning, and answer behave as stages in one information flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Articulation That Separates Meaning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech reaches its addressee by exposing and differentiating meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: meaning disclosed by speech or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); detailed separation of parts and meanings (`quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`); utterance brought out in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); eloquence that reaches the intended meaning (`quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Disclosure here is specifically linguistic: utterance is divided into intelligible parts, exposes its referent, and reaches an intended recipient. This gives the detailed signs a latent anatomy of articulate speech.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority establishes order, delegates care, and draws subjects into willing or compelled alignment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Kingship, custodial care, and bodily submission are distinct scenes joined by ordered dependence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Throne, Dominion, and Administration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sovereign occupies the raised seat, owns the domain, and manages affairs toward their outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship, mastery, and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); raised royal throne (`quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`); dominion and governing power (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); office and holder of authority (`quranic:root_000051:B003/m01`); administration by looking to consequences (`quranic:root_000458:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:1-2 `رَبّ` (ر ب ب); 13:2 `العَرْش` (ع ر ش), `الأَمْر` (ء م ر), and `يُدَبِّرُ` (د ب ر); 13:13, 13:16 `مَلَائِكَة`/`يَمْلِكُون` (م ل ك).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Throne, dominion, office, and consequence-aware administration produce a specific court of rule. The surface ordering of creation is thereby reframed as active governance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority establishes order, delegates care, and draws subjects into willing or compelled alignment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Voluntary and Compelled Submission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bodies lower themselves or are made tractable under command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prostration and lowering in submission (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); making a thing tractable for a purpose (`quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`); willing obedience (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`); acting under aversion or compulsion (`quranic:root_001295:B002/m01`); hand given in surrender (`quranic:root_001693:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tractability, willing obedience, coerced action, surrendered hand, and bodily lowering distinguish modes of alignment while preserving one relation of subjection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perception becomes orientation when light, marks, and guidance disclose a traversable direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Sight and guidance are joined through material landmarks rather than treated as generic cognition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sight, Blindness, and Illumination
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An eye either receives an illuminated field or loses access to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sight by the eye (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); loss of sight (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); seeing by eye or insight (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); light and illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:2, 13:12 `تَرَوْنَهَا`/`يُرِيكُم` (ر ء ي); 13:16 `البَصِير` (ب ص ر), `الأَعْمَى` (ع م ي), and `النُّور` (ن و ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Seeing, blindness, showing, and illumination form one perceptual scene. The contrast is not only epistemic; it is the difference between an available and unavailable visual field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Landmark and Guide
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A marked feature stands out, indicates direction, and is followed by a guide.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: distinguishing mark or route marker (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); gentle indication of road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); visible waymark or beacon (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`); sign or appointed route marker (`quranic:root_000051:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mark, beacon, and guide constitute a concrete navigation scene. Knowledge and illumination thus acquire the shape of route recognition rather than remaining abstract possession.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınma eylemini ve bu eylemin yöneldiği varlığı birlikte korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اسم الله والقول في أصله من إله، وصيغ الاستعمال مثل الله ما فعلت بمعنى والله، واللهم، ويا الله، ولاه أبوك أو لاه أنت ونحوها.

branches.source_phrase_ar: فالإله الله تعالى وسمي بذلك لأنه معبود (maqayis)؛ اسم الله الأكبر هو الله، الله ما فعلت ذاك تريد والله ما فعلته، لاه أنت أي لله أنت، لا هم اغفر لنا (ayn)؛ منه قولنا الله وأصله إلاه، يا ألله اغفر لي (sihah)؛ اسم الله الأكبر هو الله، الله ما فعلت تريد والله، اللهم بمعنى يا ألله، لاه أبوك، لهنك، لهنا، يا ألله اغفر لي (tahdhib)؛ الله قيل أصله إله فحذفت همزته وأدخل عليها الألف واللام فخص بالباري تعالى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bineğin ağır yürüyüşten daha hızlı fakat tam koşudan daha düşük bir gidişini ve hayvanın yürüyüşünü belirgin biçimde hızlandırmayı birlikte gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçim birimleri belirli bir yürüyüş türünü adlandırır; kalıba bağlı kullanım ise bineğin yürüyüşünü bu düzeye çıkarma eylemini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüşten hızlı, tam koşudan daha düşük bir hızla güçlü biçimde ilerlemesidir. Aynı alan, hayvanın yürüyüşünü bu yoğunluğa çıkarma eylemini de kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel yaklaştırma çekirdeğini açıkça verir ve kişi ya da anlatılan bir işi yönetici veya yargı yetkisi olan kimsenin önüne getirmeyi bunun kurumsal özel kullanımı olarak gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yaklaştırmayı anlatır; kişiyi, davayı veya anlatılan işi bir yetkilinin önüne sunan kalıplar bu çekirdeğin kurumsal özel kullanımlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi, özellikle gizli kalmış bir haberi açığa çıkarıp yaymayı ve bunu aktaran bir topluluğu açıkça aynı duyurma alanında toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte olma ve örtme çekirdeği önde tutulur; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımları genel yükselme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gök ve tavan çekirdeğinin yanı sıra bulut, yağmur, bitki ve bir şeyin üst yanı için belirtilen bağlı kullanımları kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.

Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.
